# 🧩 Reusable documentation templates

Replace bracketed prompts. Use synthetic data only. Never paste patient-level records or private health information.

| Template | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [Research proposal](research-proposal.md) | Define an educational/research question |
| [Experiment record](experiment-record.md) | Capture reproducible run details |
| [Dataset change](dataset-change-record.md) | Record provenance and transformations |
| [Model review](model-review.md) | Review leakage, metrics, and interpretation |
| [Issue report](issue-report.md) | Report technical problems safely |
| [PR checklist](pull-request-checklist.md) | Review completeness |
| [Risk register](risk-register.md) | Track research and governance risks |
| [Test plan](test-plan.md) | Plan synthetic and documentation checks |

Templates are not a substitute for ethics review, clinical expertise, or dataset permissions.
